# ParaGravity

> Unlimited Parallel Multi-Account & Sandbox Architecture for Google Antigravity (macOS & Windows).

ParaGravity (`pgrav`) is a native, non-invasive parallel multi-account and profile isolation manager for Google Antigravity. It enables developers to run unlimited Google Antigravity instances side-by-side on the same machine without logging out or experiencing quota exhaustion stalls.

## Key Capabilities

- **Zero-Contamination Sandboxing**: Partitions user data via Chromium's native `--user-data-dir` flag into `~/.antigravity-profiles/<profile-name>/`. Tokens, chat histories, and cookies never intermingle.
- **Quota Pool Multiplication**: Run enterprise workspace accounts and personal Gemini Pro accounts concurrently. When one hits 429 rate limits, switch to the other seamlessly.
- **Native OS Launchers**: Automatically generates macOS Spotlight launcher bundles (`~/Applications/Antigravity (<profile>).app`) and Windows Start Menu shortcuts for 0.2s instant fuzzy launching.
- **Zero Idle RAM Overhead**: Direct process execution without background daemon, electron wrapping, or persistent polling. 0 MB idle memory consumed.
- **1-Click MCP & Keybinding Inheritance**: The `-i` (`--inherit-config`) flag clones existing keybindings, editor settings, and symlinks MCP servers from the host Antigravity setup while keeping auth tokens strictly isolated.

## Installation

### macOS (One-liner curl)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edison-land/paragravity/main/install.sh | bash
```

### Windows (PowerShell / Git Bash)
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/edison-land/paragravity.git $HOME\.paragravity
# Add $HOME\.paragravity\bin to PATH
```

## CLI Cheatsheet

- `pgrav create <name> [-i]`: Provision an isolated profile. Pass `-i` to inherit keybindings and MCP configurations.
- `pgrav launch <name>`: Launch the specified profile sandbox window.
- `pgrav list`: Inspect all configured profile sandboxes and active running instances.
- `pgrav remove <name>`: Cleanly delete a sandbox profile and its Spotlight launcher.
- `pgrav doctor`: Run self-diagnostic checks across binary paths, sandbox permissions, and symlinks.
